description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a function to split a string into a linked list of tokens based on spaces. It includes helper functions for token validation and utilizes an external 'LinkedList' class.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: An object that provides string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of these tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is valid.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is non-empty.
